messages.subject: Tečaji statistike na Škotskem
parts:
Pozdravljeni, Rkoholiki!

Ekipa PRstatistics s Škotske vabi na tečaje statistike, usmerjene v celo
paleto različnih področij biologije.
Lanskega novembra sem se udeležila odličnega tečaja "Spatial analysis of
ecological data using R", zato z veseljem delim informacijo o
prihajajočih tečajih dalje.
Če koga kaj od tega zanima, kontakt organizatorja najdete spodaj.

LP, Urša

------------------

Hi Ursa,

I hope you are well and you were able to put to use some of the things
you learnt during the course at SCENE.

We have a lot more courses planned this year and I am trying to get them
circulated around as many organisations as possible, I was hoping to ask
a favor, would you mind circulating this email (which lists our next 10
courses) if possible?

Thanks in advance,

Oliver

1) Advancing in statistical modelling using R (ADVR)
Date: 2 May 2016 - 6 May 2016
Instructors: Dr. Luc Bussière, Dr. Tom Houslay
http://prstatistics.com/course/advancing-in-statistical-modelling-using-r-advr/

http://prstatistics.com/course/time-series-models-for-ecologists-and-climatologist/
